summary.text: NORDRE NORDSETER SAMEIE DA is a partnership with shared liability registered in Fåberg, founded 2002-03-13. Its registered activity: "Forvaltningen av vårt sameie på Nordseter i Lillehammer kommune som har betegnelsen gnr. 192 bnr. 1 i Lillehammer kommune." Its main industry code is 68.200: rental and operating of own or leased real estate. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 456 343 NOK and the annual result was 330 893 NOK; operating income was up from 343 787 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 229 815 NOK in 2024 to 330 893 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 1 129 562 NOK in 2024 to 1 175 455 NOK in 2025. Recent changes in the register: business address set to co/Kristian Dahl on 2026-08-24.
